gaps.explanation: The governmental funds statement (p4) prints three columns: General Fund, Special Revenue Fund and Debt Service Fund. detail[] has only the General (p7) and Special Fund (p8) budget schedules; the Debt Service Fund has no schedule. Its p4 column: Property taxes 362,661 + Interest income 11,697 = Total revenues collected 374,358 = the gap. 1,041,989 + 374,358 = 1,416,347 (statement total).
